 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Tile four orientations of a square grid into a 2x2 output."""
    n = len(grid)
    if any(len(row) != n for row in grid):
        raise ValueError("expected a square grid")
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [grid[r] + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)] + [
        counterclockwise[r] + half_turn[r] for r in range(n)
    ]
"
